variants.displayName: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE SHIP UNDER ATTACK
variants.briefing:
This one is urgent. A transport ship of ours is currently under attack. They were able to share their last known location of [Location] shortly before losing contact.

Since this is a high-risk situation, we strongly suggest you bring backup. I have every confidence that you and your crew will be able to occupy the outlaws long enough for the ship to complete repairs and escape with its cargo.

Outside of the contract’s payment, you’ll receive credit for the resources they deliver.

Looking forward to hearing of your success.

Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer

All the best,

variants.briefing:
It seems that a contractor of ours had an issue with their delivery and abandoned their cargo over at [Location].

This cargo is incredibly important to the resource drive and we need them recovered.

Once you’re ready, head over to [Location] with the appropriate equipment (like a tractor beam) and retrieve the cargo. Expect to find between 50-55 SCU of various box sizes. 

Also, in order to guarantee the cargo’s safety, be on the lookout for any hostiles in the area. Once secured, deliver the resources to a freight elevator at: [Destination]. My colleagues will secure it.

You may even find that the cargo ship is still operational, so if you have another pilot with you, it may be worth using that ship to deliver everything. We’ll leave that decision with you.

Kind Regards,

Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech

variants.briefing:
A group of outlaws have been targeting our smaller transport ships and as a result, a number of crucial resources that are needed for the UEE’s drive have been stolen from us.

Our trackers are showing that these outlaws have spread the cargo across several locations. We need someone who can work as a part of a wider recovery team and retrieve the portion of the shipment being stashed at [Location]. The outlaws there will be heavily armed, so plan accordingly.

Once you have the [ItemsToRecover] cargo boxes (all [MaxBoxSize] SCU or smaller) in your possession, deliver them to a freight elevator at: [Destination]. In addition to the specific materials you personally return, you will share credit for all the stolen items recovered from other sites.

Looking forward to hearing of your success.

Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer

variants.briefing:
Got an urgent contract: a small cargo ship of ours is currently under attack by outlaws.

Our team was able to pinpoint their location to [Location], but they’ve stopped responding to comms.

Head to their location and see if you can keep the outlaws occupied long enough for our hauler to escape.

If the hauler is able to escape, I will personally ensure you are credited for any cargo they deliver.

Good luck and do your best.

Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer

variants.briefing:
Here at microTech, we are committed to supporting the Empire and its people through these turbulent times. That’s why we’re delighted to announce that we will be participating in Imperator Addison’s Second Life initiative and competing side by side with the other corporations of Stanton to provide the resources needed to end the regen crisis once and for all.

We’re looking for highly skilled contractors that can help support us in our work. If you believe you’re able to do this, we would welcome you to complete this preliminary hauling contract before providing you with additional work.

You will need a ship able to transport [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers and a multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment for this delivery. The shipment is waiting to be collected from the freight elevator at [Location] and should be delivered to a freight elevator at: [Destination].

The public declaration of each corporation's donations is a key part of this initiative. To access this information, please consult the Second Life Resource Drive section of your mobiGlas Journal. As an added reward, microTech will provide bonuses to contractors who meet productivity goals.

Let’s work together for the betterment of Humanity.

Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech
